name: Law & Order
description: In cases ripped from the headlines, police investigate serious and often deadly crimes, weighing the evidence and questioning the suspects until someone is taken into custody. The district attorney's office then builds a case to convict the perpetrator by proving the person guilty beyond a reasonable doubt. Working together, these expert teams navigate all sides of the complex criminal justice system to make New York a safer place.

videos.title: Prescription for Death
videos.overview: When a young woman dies during a hectic emergency room night shift, her father claims the hospital was negligent, and an investigation leads the detectives to believe that the doctor treating her may have been drunk on duty.

videos.title: Subterranean Homeboy Blues
videos.overview: The shooting of two black men by a white woman in a crowded subway initially appears to be a case of self-defense, but further investigation reveals revenge as a possible motive.

videos.title: The Reaper's Helper
videos.overview: The death of a man with AIDS appears to be the work of a serial killer who may have been motivated by mercy.

videos.title: Kiss the Girls and Make Them Die
videos.overview: Stone has difficulty prosecuting a privileged preppie with a history of abusing his girlfriends after one of them dies at his hands.

videos.title: Happily Ever After
videos.overview: Greevey and Logan have a hunch that robbery is a cover for the real motive in the death of a millionaire in a parking garage.

videos.title: Everybody's Favorite Bagman
videos.overview: The mugging of a councilman leads the detectives to arrest a mobster, who in turn leads Stone and Robinette to corrupt city officials.

videos.title: By Hooker, By Crook
videos.overview: When Logan and Greevey investigate how a family man came to be found unconscious in Central Park, they uncover a very high-class call girl operation run by a well-educated socialite.

videos.title: Poison Ivy
videos.overview: The shooting of a black honors student stirs up racial tensions, especially after it becomes apparent that the cop responsible for the death may have planted a gun on the body to excuse the shooting.

videos.title: Indifference
videos.overview: During the investigation into the death of a little girl in a respectable, middle-class family, Greevey and Logan uncover a myriad of family secrets involving abuse, molestation, and murder.

videos.title: Prisoner of Love
videos.overview: A city arts commissioner and a socialite come under investigation when an artist noted for his sadomasochistic themes is found dead under suspicious circumstances.

videos.title: Out of the Half-Light
videos.overview: Greevey and Logan's investigation into a black teenager's claim that she was raped by white policemen is hampered by a publicity hungry, black politician who will not grant the detectives access to the victim.

videos.title: Life Choice
videos.overview: Stone faces pressure from the public and from Schiff as he prepares to prosecute the person accused of bombing an abortion clinic.

videos.title: A Death in the Family
videos.overview: Police start a citywide manhunt for a man suspected of killing a cop during a rooftop pursuit.

videos.title: The Violence of Summer
videos.overview: Greevey and Logan reopen an investigation to help Stone and Robinette build a stronger case against three boys accused of gang-raping a TV reporter.

videos.title: The Torrents of Greed (1)
videos.overview: An assault on a candy storeowner leads Stone and Robinette to build a case against a powerful mafia don.

videos.title: The Torrents of Greed (2)
videos.overview: Stone tries to salvage his prosecution of the Masucci family when Beigel faces bribery charges and seems willing to turn against his brother-in-law.

videos.title: Mushrooms
videos.overview: The accidental shooting of two children by a 14-year-old hired killer leads to a drug dealer and a real estate agent.

videos.title: The Secret Sharers
videos.overview: Stone faces a flashy Texas lawyer and a hostile community as he tries to prosecute a young man accused of killing a drug dealer.

videos.title: The Serpent's Tooth
videos.overview: Two brothers appear to be the logical suspects in the murder of their wealthy parents.

videos.title: The Troubles
videos.overview: Logan is forced to face his cultural biases when both a Cuban drug dealer and an Irish terrorist are suspected of killing a Lebanese gunrunner.

videos.title: Sonata for Solo Organ
videos.overview: Stone and Robinette prosecute a surgeon and the wealthy father of a transplant patient for illegally obtaining a kidney.

videos.title: The Blue Wall
videos.overview: Cragen comes under suspicion when his mentor in the department is investigated for laundering drug money.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Logan crosses the line in order to obtain a confession from the man suspected of murdering Max Greevey. Stone finds that his prosecution is placed in jeopardy because of Logan's actions.

videos.title: The Wages of Love
videos.overview: A double homicide casts suspicion on both the ex-wife and the former boyfriend of the murdered duo, with the dead man's murdered son holding the key to the mystery.

videos.title: Aria
videos.overview: A lethal drug overdose leads the detectives to an aggressive stage mother and a pornographic movie producer.

videos.title: Asylum
videos.overview: The conviction of a homeless man for murder is threatened on appeal based on the lack of a search warrant for his "home", which was a lean-to in Central Park.

videos.title: God Bless the Child
videos.overview: A couple faces trial after they deny medical help to their daughter based on their religious beliefs.

videos.title: Misconception
videos.overview: The mugging of a pregnant legal secretary leads to a case involving her lover, her boss and charges of murder when she loses the baby.

videos.title: In Memory Of
videos.overview: The renovation of a brownstone uncovers the remains of a boy who disappeared 31 years earlier, reviving a wrenching and long-suppressed memory in his childhood friend and neighbor.

videos.title: Out of Control
videos.overview: The detectives investigate the gang rape of a college student during a fraternity Holloween party.

videos.title: Renunciation
videos.overview: A hit-and-run investigation leads to the discovery of a schoolteacher carrying on an affair with one of her students. Cerreta and Logan suspect that she may have manipulated him into killing her husband.

videos.title: Heaven
videos.overview: The investigation into a social-club fire which claimed 53 fatalities leads to a connection between arson, illegal immigrants and the sale of green cards.

videos.title: His Hour Upon the Stage
videos.overview: The discovery of a frozen corpse in a dumpster leads to rival Broadway producers.

videos.title: Star Struck
videos.overview: An obsessive fan pleads temporary insanity when he is charged with attempting to murder the soap-opera actress who is the center of his life.

videos.title: Severance
videos.overview: Stone faces an old rival in court as he tries to link a hit man and three murders to a sleazy lawyer and a powerful man behind bars.

videos.title: Blood Is Thicker...
videos.overview: An apparent mugging ends in the death of a wealthy woman but the case comes to hang on a silver pin that may have been in the victim's possession.

videos.title: Trust
videos.overview: Stone is determined to see that a teenage boy doesn't get away with murder twice when the young man is brought to trial for the shooting death of one of his friends.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: The parents of a murdered woman contest Stone's prosecution of her killer so that he can be extradited to their home state, where the death penalty still exists.

videos.title: Sisters of Mercy
videos.overview: Cerreta and Logan investigate the accusation that a nun in charge of a shelter for teens molested a young addict.

videos.title: Cradle to Grave
videos.overview: The discovery of a dead baby leads to a case involving a slumlord who would not provide any heat and who defends her actions by blaming the rent laws.

videos.title: The Fertile Fields
videos.overview: The brutal murder of a Jewish jeweler appears to be a hate crime, but the investigation soon leads back to the man's brother and his shady business deals.

videos.title: Intolerance
videos.overview: When a Chinese-American honors student is killed, the investigation uncovers a racist mother who's son was competing with the victim for the same scholarship.

videos.title: Silence
videos.overview: A politician opposes the prosecution of his son's murderer because it might mean revealing that his late son was gay.

videos.title: The Working Stiff
videos.overview: The murder of a Wall Street legend begins a case involving an ailing union worker and a former governor and old friend of Schiff's.

videos.title: Skin Deep
videos.overview: When a sleazy photographer is murdered, his models appear to be the most likely suspects.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: The assassination of an African-American leader leads to the arrest of a man whose ex-wife was suspected of having an affair with the victim.

videos.title: Forgiveness
videos.overview: A priest-turned-lawyer uses race and class as the basis for his defense of a young Mexican man who murdered his wealthy girlfriend after she broke up with him.

videos.title: The Corporate Veil
videos.overview: A teenager's fatal heart attack is traced to fraud and greed on the part of the manufacturer of his pacemaker and their supplier.

videos.title: Wedded Bliss
videos.overview: The discovery of a young woman's body in the river leads to an investigation of illegal sweatshops and the enslavement of young immigrants.

videos.title: Helpless
videos.overview: Dr. Olivet accuses her gynecologist of rape, but Stone finds his case in trouble when he discovers that Olivet tape-recorded the crime.

videos.title: Self Defense
videos.overview: Cerreta and Stone find themselves on opposite sides of the fence when a storeowner kills two robbers and then claims self-defense as a justification.

videos.title: Prince of Darkness
videos.overview: Cerreta poses as a weapons dealer to help Stone build a case against a Columbian hit man, but the deal takes an unexpected turn, resulting in bloodshed.

videos.title: Point of View
videos.overview: Logan gets a new partner and Stone faces an old friend from law school as they investigate a woman's claim of self-defense in the shooting death of a small time hood.

videos.title: Consultation
videos.overview: An engineer and a tribal chief become the chief suspects in the death of a Nigerian woman who died while smuggling heroin internally.

videos.title: Extended Family
videos.overview: The apparent abduction of a little girl by her natural mother becomes complicated by charges of sexual molestation.

videos.title: Right to Counsel
videos.overview: After Stone accepts a plea bargain from the much younger and poorer lover of a wealthy older woman found murdered in her apartment, he begins to have doubts that he has sent the right man to prison, especially as he learns more about the attorney who handled the woman's estate.

videos.title: Night and Fog
videos.overview: The confession of an elderly man that he assisted his wife in committing suicide doesn't fully satisfy Stone when rumors surface that the man was once a Nazi collaborator.

videos.title: Promises to Keep
videos.overview: The investigation into the murder of a young physician leads to the discovery of an unorthodox and illegal relationship between her fiance and his psychiatrist.

videos.title: Mother Love
videos.overview: The absence of a murder weapon complicates the investigation into the murder of a drug addict who stole from her family to support her habit.

videos.title: Jurisdiction
videos.overview: Stone battles the Brooklyn DA's office over prosecutorial jurisdiction in the case of a mentally handicapped man who confesses to the stabbing deaths of two women.

videos.title: Conduct Unbecoming
videos.overview: Stone and the police battle the closed ranks of the Navy to investigate the death of a female Naval officer during a party in a Manhattan hotel.

videos.title: Animal Instinct
videos.overview: The initial investigation into the death of a research scientist leads to an animal-rights group until evidence surfaces that her husband's affair with a coworker may point to a possible motive for the murder.

videos.title: Virus
videos.overview: While investigating several deaths at a diabetes clinic, Briscoe and Logan discover that teenage computer hackers may have tampered with the clinic's medical database.

videos.title: Securitate
videos.overview: When a Romanian immigrant kills, his lawyer announces he will plead his client "not guilty due to cultural insanity" claiming the man had been conditioned to violence in his homeland.

videos.title: Manhood
videos.overview: The statement of a drug dealer who survived a shoot-out that killed a cop leads Logan and Briscoe to suspect that the cop died because he was gay and his fellow officers were reluctant to back him up.

videos.title: Benevolence
videos.overview: Logan and Briscoe begin their investigation into the death of a hearing-impaired young woman by questioning her two most recent boyfriends.

videos.title: Sweeps
videos.overview: A guest is murdered on-air on a controversial talk show. Meanwhile Logan and Briscoe have a new boss, Lt. Anita Van Buren, and Stone gets a new collague; the police and district attorney attempt to prosecute the show's abrasive host.

videos.title: Volunteers
videos.overview: A disruptive, unbalanced homeless man is found severely beaten in an alley of the middle class neighborhood he calls home, leading Stone to try and prosecute one of the residents for premeditated murder.

videos.title: Discord
videos.overview: A college student charges an admittedly promiscuous rock star with rape, but he claims the act was consensual.

videos.title: Profile
videos.overview: Stone finds himself up against an ambitious black lawyer defending a white, racist serial killer.

videos.title: Black Tie
videos.overview: The police suspect a cover up when they receive an anonymous tip that a wealthy man was murdered by his wife, who refuses to allow an autopsy after a physician declares that the death occurred from natural causes.

videos.title: Pride and Joy
videos.overview: A 17-year-old boy becomes the chief suspect in the murder of his father, raising questions of self-defense and abuse that the family does not want to face.

videos.title: Apocrypha
videos.overview: Stone and Kincaid try to prove that the young woman believed to have planted a bomb in a parking garage had been brainwashed and was acting under the direct orders of a charismatic cult leader.

videos.title: American Dream
videos.overview: A skeleton unearthed at a building site resurrects one of Stone's old cases, and brings him face to face with the tenacious, brilliant culprit, who is seeking a new trial.

videos.title: Born Bad
videos.overview: A lawyer decides to defend her teenage client charged with murder as an adult with the claim that he's violent because of a genetic predisposition due to an extra Y chromosome.

videos.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
videos.overview: A "green-card" bride from Russia is suspected of murdering her rich, but cold husband, who was threatening to divorce her just weeks before she would qualify to remain in this country.

videos.title: Golden Years
videos.overview: An emaciated elderly woman is found dead of an apparent heart attack and her granddaughter is charged with neglect and grave indifference to human life.

videos.title: Snatched
videos.overview: A millionaire friend of Schiff's won't cooperate with the police following his son's kidnapping.

videos.title: Breeder
videos.overview: While investigating a woman's claim that she passed out in a taxi and awoke to find her newborn missing, Briscoe and Logan uncover a scam involving private adoptions.

videos.title: Censure
videos.overview: A phone call threatening a woman's young daughter leads to a case that causes Kincaid to resign from Schiff's office because of an affair in her past.

videos.title: Kids
videos.overview: A 14-year-old's shooting death involves the son of a former police detective, who's also an old friend of Briscoe's.

videos.title: Big Bang
videos.overview: A scientist becomes the chief suspect when his estranged wife, who's been delaying divorce proceedings, is the victim of a letter bomb.

videos.title: Mayhem
videos.overview: During a 24-hour period, Briscoe and Logan have a heavy caseload that includes 5 unrelated murders and a domestic quarrel, which results in the maiming of the husband.

videos.title: Wager
videos.overview: Briscoe and Logan bet that the killing of a star athlete's father is linked to gambling debts and threats to the baseball player's family.

videos.title: Sanctuary
videos.overview: A black minister fans the flames of racial intolerance after a hit-and-run in Harlem claims the life of a 12-year-old and the Jewish driver isn't indicted.

videos.title: Nurture
videos.overview: Briscoe and Logan investigate the disappearance of a child from her abusive foster home and find her being held by a loving but disturbed woman who insists she has acted only for the child's own good.

videos.title: Doubles
videos.overview: An assailant breaks the wrist of a tennis player prior to a tournament, and a competitor is among the suspects.

videos.title: Old Friends
videos.overview: A truck hits a pedestrian and the investigation reveals the victim's link to a baby-food company in which a new partner has connections to the Russian mob.

videos.title: Second Opinion
videos.overview: A woman's death exposes an unorthodox method of treating cancer that Executive Assistant DA McCoy intends to prove is negligent homicide.

videos.title: Coma
videos.overview: A comedy-club owner comes under suspicion for having shot his wife, now comatose with a bullet in her head, after it's discovered he was abusive and she was about to divorce him.

videos.title: Blue Bamboo
videos.overview: The killing of a Japanese nightclub owner who was visiting New York leads to the arrest of a singer who once worked for the deceased, and whose lawyer uses the ""battered-woman syndrome"" as a defense.

videos.title: Family Values
videos.overview: After it's determined that a wealthy woman did not commit suicide but was murdered, the detectives question both her first and second husbands and her teenage daughter.

videos.title: White Rabbit
videos.overview: A routine investigation uncovers evidence that leads Briscoe and Logan to a long-time fugitive, a radical Vietnam War opponent on the run since a 1971 burglary that left a policeman dead.

videos.title: Competence
videos.overview: When Lt. Van Buren is the victim of an attempted holdup by two teens, she fires her gun and kills one of them, and the detectives are faced with the fact that she shot an unarmed child in the back.

videos.title: Precious
videos.overview: When Briscoe and Logan suspect that a missing infant may have been murdered by her parents rather than kidnapped, they uncover a terrible family secret which hides a mentally ill serial killer.

videos.title: Virtue
videos.overview: McCoy uses a charge of ""larceny by extortion"" against a councilman, whose former colleague claims he demanded sex in exchange for a law-firm partnership.

videos.title: Scoundrels
videos.overview: Among the suspects in a lawyer's murder are a swindler, who conned a woman out of her family fortune, and the woman's once-wealthy son.

videos.title: House Counsel
videos.overview: The killing of a man who had served as a juror in a mob trial leads to a battle of wills between McCoy and his long-time friend, the suspect's attorney.

videos.title: Guardian
videos.overview: After the body of a young female junkie is identified as the daughter of a wealthy family, Briscoe and Logan try to find out who left her to die in the yard of a day-care center.

videos.title: Progeny
videos.overview: The investigation into the killing of an abortion clinic doctor leads to an activist group led by a former priest.

videos.title: Rage
videos.overview: A Wall Street broker accused of murdering his mentor uses the defense of ""black rage"" in court.

videos.title: Performance
videos.overview: Briscoe and Logan set out to identify the apparent victim in a snuff film, but find her alive and really the victim of a points-for-sex club at her prestigious high school.

videos.title: Seed
videos.overview: A routine investigation into a woman's death leads Briscoe and Logan to a fertility doctor guilty of unethical practices, but who cannot apparently be touched because of confidentiality rules, and patient reluctance to talk.

videos.title: Wannabe
videos.overview: The shooting of a board member of an exclusive private school leads to a blue-collar family and a classist system.

videos.title: Act of God
videos.overview: A bomb at a construction site kills a 12-year-old boy, and the suspects include the bankrupt contractor and a jealous husband.

videos.title: Privileged
videos.overview: The investigation into a double murder leads to a young alcoholic whose family once lived in the victims' house and who had admitted to his AA group that he's had nightmares about killings.

videos.title: Cruel and Unusual
videos.overview: The death of an autistic youth in custody reveals a multitude of unusual and possibly illegal therapies being used, but also parents reluctant to pursue a prosecution.

videos.title: Bad Faith
videos.overview: Logan relives unhappy childhood memories when a friend is found dead, a presumed suicide, until the investigation reveals recent contact with a former priest, with a history of pedophilia.

videos.title: Purple Heart
videos.overview: The investigation into a taxi driver's murder involves a loan shark, a forged check, a missing plumber and the victim's wife.

videos.title: Switch
videos.overview: Suspects in a psychiatrist's murder include the victim's ex-husband, a patient suffering from multiple-personality disorder and her obstructive father.

videos.title: Pride
videos.overview: A gay city councilman is murdered and the trail leads to a bigoted rival politician and a male prostitute.

videos.title: Bitter Fruit
videos.overview: Briscoe and his new partner, Det. Reynaldo Curtis, investigate the murder of a young girl who disappeared between school and her music lesson, with a blurry film from an ATM machine as their clue.

videos.title: Rebels
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis have a hard time finding cooperative witnesses when investigating the murder of a college student at a rough biker bar.

videos.title: Savages
videos.overview: McCoy and Kincaid clash over the death penalty as McCoy prosecutes a man who murdered an undercover cop during a drug bust.

videos.title: Jeopardy
videos.overview: A triple murder at a magazine publishing company leads to a case of sibling rivalry, a protective matriarch and a corrupt judge.

videos.title: Hot Pursuit
videos.overview: When the detectives solve a series of murders committed by a holdup team in ski masks, McCoy must determine whether a young woman found with them is an unwilling hostage, or an active participant in the crimes.

videos.title: Paranoia
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis try to solve a co-ed's murder after a graphic description appears online, while McCoy finds himself up against a lawyer who is reluctant to reveal elements of her client's past.

videos.title: Humiliation
videos.overview: The investigation into a prostitute's murder leads to a married plastic surgeon as the obvious suspect, but Kincaid has a hunch that an elaborate frame-up is in play.

videos.title: Angel
videos.overview: A mother claiming that her baby was kidnapped while she was at confession retraces her steps and actions with Curtis, which raises legal questions later when her attorney introduces a unique defense.

videos.title: Blood Libel
videos.overview: A hidden anti-Semitic message in a high school yearbook offers a clue to an art teacher's murder and leads to a case that matches McCoy against "Klan lawyer" Roy Payne.

videos.title: Remand
videos.overview: The victim in a 30-year-old rape and stabbing case is fearful when information received by Briscoe and Curtis creates the possibility of a new trial for the perpetrator.

videos.title: Corpus Delicti
videos.overview: The death of a show horse leads to a trial involving insurance fraud, a sting operation and a wealthy woman's disappearance.

videos.title: Trophy
videos.overview: McCoy finds that his career is on the line when his former female assistant and ex lover accuses him of forging evidence that helped put an innocent man in prison.

videos.title: Charm City (I)
videos.overview:
A subway station gas attack, similar to one that took place in a Baltimore church five years earlier, brings Baltimore detectives Tim Bayliss and Frank Pembleton to New York to assist Briscoe and Curtis.

This crossover continues on Homicide: Life on the Street S04E12 For God and Country (II).

videos.title: Custody
videos.overview: Paul Robinette places the system on trial when he defends a young black woman accused of kidnapping her biological baby from his white, adoptive parents.

videos.title: Encore
videos.overview: A jogger killed in Central Park turns out to be the second wife of a former comedy club owner, who was acquitted of killing his first wife. And convicting him this time may hinge on tracing the path of a Columbian coin used as a subway token slug.

videos.title: Savior
videos.overview: A down-on-his-luck ad executive becomes the prime suspect when his wife and son are killed, and his daughter wounded on a night that he claims was spent drinking.

videos.title: Deceit
videos.overview: When a young attorney is murdered shortly after he decides to file a sexual harassment claim against his employer, Briscoe and Curtis quickly discover that the alleged harasser and his wife each have an excellent motive for murder.

videos.title: Atonement
videos.overview: The investigation into the murder of a model with a passion for cocaine and partying focuses on the men in her life -- a nightclub owner, a basketball player, a photographer and a limousine driver.

videos.title: Slave
videos.overview: A woman is shot while sleeping, and the investigation leads the police to a boy whose crack-addicted mother has entrusted him to a dealer's care.

videos.title: Girlfriends
videos.overview: After a college co-ed's body is found, the detectives look for a campus rapist, but the medical examiner's report puts them on a different path, one involving prostitution.

videos.title: Pro Se
videos.overview: The investigation into multiple homicides at a clothing store leads to the arrest of a schizophrenic who presents McCoy with a formidable opponent when he decides to represent himself.

videos.title: Homesick
videos.overview: After an infant is found dead in his crib, it's determined he was poisoned, and all evidence points to the child's au pair.

videos.title: Aftershock
videos.overview: After Briscoe, Curtis, McCoy, and Kincaid witness the execution of a criminal they brought to justice, their unique reactions to the event culminate in personal tragedies for each of them.

videos.title: Causa Mortis
videos.overview: McCoy's new second chair, ADA Jamie Ross, is determined to prosecute as harshly as possible a carjacker who took the life of a teacher as she pleaded for her life on an audio tape discovered at the crime scene.

videos.title: I.D.
videos.overview: The cops tackle identifying a corpse left in an elevator, and McCoy finds his prosecution of the suspect later hampered by a vindictive judge who resents Ross's in-court rebuke for sexual harassment.

videos.title: Good Girl
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis have to break the mutual alibi of two girlfriends as they try to find the killer of a young black man, whose angry parents pressure McCoy to indict a young woman who claims the victim had raped her.

videos.title: Survivor
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis's investigation of the murder of a rare coin dealer nets them a millionaire as a suspect, but Ross has to play detective too as the DA's office tries to establish a provenance for the missing coin collection.

videos.title: Corruption
videos.overview: Curtis, angered by the attitude of an old colleague of Briscoe's, looks beyond the findings of an IAB investigation and turns up evidence of police corruption that puts the DA's office into competition with an ambitious judge and Briscoe under investigation for stealing evidence from a police lockup.

videos.title: Double Blind
videos.overview: The murder of a janitor in a university laboratory building leads back to a student employee whose participation in a drug study may have prompted the crime.

videos.title: Deadbeat
videos.overview: The murder of a deadbeat father whose son is dying of leukemia presents McCoy and Ross with a sympathetic suspect and a moral dilemma.

videos.title: Family Business
videos.overview: The murder of Richard Speigel, chief financial officer for an exclusive, family-owned department store goes from the sitting room to the bedroom and into the board room as suspicion shifts from co-workers to family members.

videos.title: Entrapment
videos.overview: The case against Huey Tate, a young man accused of shooting the well-known leader of the African-American Congress comes undone when the New York authorities learn that their chief witness was once an informant for the FBI, and is still under their protection.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: The sidewalk shooting of a young husband uncovers the fact that his wife's first husband died in a inadequately investigated accident, and that they may have been having an affair before it happened.

videos.title: Menace
videos.overview: The detectives face a difficult struggle getting witnesses to a girl's apparent suicide to come forward while Ross tries to prove that a known bully is the one really responsible for her actions.

videos.title: Barter
videos.overview: An unpromising case of murder suddenly develops new leads when the cops explore the possibility that the victim was mistaken for someone else. McCoy walks a thin line in the matter of ethical conduct as he tries to make a case against a lendor who uses unscrupulous methods to collect the money owed to him.

videos.title: Matrimony
videos.overview: The discovery of a would-be thief refocuses a murder investigation, leaving the prosecutors the task of making a conspiracy case against the deceased's attorney and the pretty young widow.

videos.title: Working Mom
videos.overview: The murder of an ex-cop with a penchant for blackmail and illicit sex brings feminist lawyer Lanie Stieglitz into court against McCoy to defend a suburban wife and mother.

videos.title: D-Girl
videos.overview: A headless corpse fished out of the river sends Briscoe and Curtis out to Los Angeles to obtain a blood sample from their chief suspect while McCoy and Ross back in New York try to obtain a court order for the procedure.

videos.title: Turnaround
videos.overview: Back in New York with their suspect, Briscoe and Curtis try to pin down his schedule on the night of the murder, but find instead that another man was in the area at the right time and more importantly, might have a motive for the crime. But after the issuance of a new arrest warrant, McCoy and Ross have to fly to LA to defend their warrant against attacks by the man's defense counsel, Ross's former husband Neal Gorton.

videos.title: Showtime
videos.overview: The trial of Eddie Newman begins but the prosecution's chances of conviction are hampered by a "dream team" of defense attorneys, Gorton's personal pressures on Ross, the public questioning of the relationship between Curtis and Lisa Lundquist, and a surprise accusation.

videos.title: Mad Dog
videos.overview: McCoy becomes obsessed with nailing a serial rapist recently released on parole and pushes the cops perilously close to harassment as he attempts to connect the man with a new rape and murder matching his previous M.O.

videos.title: Double Down
videos.overview: The cops' best hope of finding a kidnapped hired car driver alive is one of the armed robbers who grabbed him after a job, but the immunity deal he demands in return would effectively preclude his prosecution for the shooting death of an off-duty cop, placing McCoy in a difficult position as he seeks to placate the cops, who want the guy prosecuted, and the kidnapped man's wife, who wants every avenue of saving her husband explored.

videos.title: We Like Mike
videos.overview: A young man who claims to have helped a murdered young man change a flat tire is first the cops' primary suspect, then the prosecutors' chief witness.

videos.title: Passion
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the death of a pretty young book editor who was reputedly having an affair with one of her authors, and find themselves focusing on the author's long time companion, who steadfastly denies there was anything wrong with their relationship.

videos.title: Past Imperfect
videos.overview: The cops have a definite clue when a bloodstain that's not the same as the victim reveals that the killer was a blood relative, and the prosecutors stumble when their chief suspect claims their chief witness is her lawyer, and his knowledge of the crime represents privileged communications.

videos.title: Terminal
videos.overview: The cops uncover a man with a secret second life as they try to learn who opened fire on a group of people disembarking from a party cruise, but his guilt or innocence becomes almost a second thought as Schiff goes toe to toe with the governor and the States Attorney General over the decision to seek the death penalty.

videos.title: Thrill
videos.overview: The cops break the seemingly random murder of a pizza delivery guy with a little ""undercover"" work in the park, but McCoy and Ross face a harder battle to get a conviction when the two defendants resolutely point the finger at each other, and the one item identifying the actual killer is the recording of a confession-made to a priest.

videos.title: Denial
videos.overview: Bloody sheets and an apparently stolen credit card lead Briscoe and Curtis to a pair of college age lovers who present McCoy and Ross with a united front of denial that one of them killed their newborn son and disposed of the body.

videos.title: Navy Blues
videos.overview: McCoy finds himself battling the Navy and the office of the Judge Advocate General as he tries to prosecute a female pilot accused of murdering her married lover after he tried to break off with her.

videos.title: Harvest
videos.overview: A discrepancy concerning the time of death of a drive-by shooting victim leads McCoy and Ross to initiate prosecutions against both the shooter and the doctor who harvested her organs as transplant donations.

videos.title: Nullification
videos.overview: After the cops trace an eagle tattoo on a man shot and killed while holding up an armored truck to a group of militia members, McCoy finds himself facing one of their number as the pro se counsel for his friends, arguing for the concept of "jury nullification", the right of a jury to protect a defendant from an unjust law by finding him not guilty despite the evidence.

videos.title: Baby, It's You (I)
videos.overview:
It's old home week for Briscoe when an apparent murder of a teenage model in New York develops ties to Baltimore and Detectives Munch and Falsone pay a visit to the Big Apple to observe the case. Meanwhile, McCoy finds himself battling the attorney of the victim's parents for access to his clients and the Baltimore DA for jurisdiction.

This crossover continues on Homicide: Life on the Street S06E05 Baby, It's You (II).

videos.title: Blood
videos.overview: The paternity of a black baby given up for adoption by a white mother might provide a clue to her murderer but it also unearths some long buried family secrets.

videos.title: Shadow
videos.overview: The murder of a bail bondsman looks fairly routine until the chance words of the chief suspect uncovers possible case-fixing between a shady lawyer and an unknown contact within the judicial system.

videos.title: Burned
videos.overview: A message overheard on an answering machine leads Briscoe and Curtis to a confessed murderer and the home of wealthy Carl Anderton, whose stubborn non-cooperation with the district attorney threatens to create a serious miscarriage of justice.

videos.title: Ritual
videos.overview: The investigation into the death of a man who initially appears to be the victim of a mugging victim reveals him to be a Middle Eastern physician who performs genital mutilations on young girls.

videos.title: Under the Influence
videos.overview: After Briscoe and Curtis finally determine who was driving the car that killed three people, the legal prosecution stands in danger of becoming a kangaroo court when McCoy's feelings over Kincaid mesh with the political agenda of an ambitious judge anxious to make an example of the defendant.

videos.title: Expert
videos.overview: The shooting of two people in a restaurant restroom takes some abrupt turns as they try to discover who exactly the intended victim was, and the prosecutors have to deal with a defendant claiming to have been in a dissociative state while committing the crime-- the same defense used years before by the defendant's father.

videos.title: Castoff
videos.overview: The street murder of a woman who worked with underprivileged kids takes a turn towards the bizarre when the detectives uncover she had a predilection for kinky sex, and that one of her current partners appears to be a serial killer, who offers an overexposure to television violence as his defense during his trial.

videos.title: Grief
videos.overview: The cops, as they try to pin down the specifics of an assault on a man reluctant to talk about it, uncover the alleged rape of two women in custodial care. But as the prosecutors attempt to prepare their case, a reluctant witness changes their view of the cases.

videos.title: Faccia a Faccia
videos.overview: Taking on an apparent mafia murder, Detectives Briscoe and Curtis are stymied by a dead witness and a seemingly incoherent mob boss.

videos.title: Divorce
videos.overview: The stabbing death of a psychologist draws Detectives Briscoe and Curtis into a heated divorce case and pits McCoy and Ross against a manipulative attorney.

videos.title: Carrier
videos.overview: The death of a college student leads to a case involving an HIV-positive male who's seeking to infect as many young women as possible. McCoy, testing right-to-privacy ethics, wants to charge him with murder.

videos.title: Stalker
videos.overview: When a woman is found unconscious at the bottom of her apartment stairs, Briscoe and Curtis must figure out what happened -- before it's too late. In order to make his case, McCoy pits the two detectives against each other in the courtroom.

videos.title: Disappeared
videos.overview: A defendant refuses to allow his lawyer to raise the issue of insanity, this complicating matters for the brother who turned him in with hopes of securing medical treatment for him.

videos.title: Burden
videos.overview: After a 12-year-old quadriplegic dies at home in his bed, paramedics claim that he was suffocated and the suspects include the boy's parents and sister.

videos.title: Bad Girl
videos.overview: Schiff's re-election may hinge on the stabbing death of a police officer; Briscoe's daughter is arrested for dealing drugs.

videos.title: Damaged
videos.overview: The case of a teacher's shooting uncovers a vendetta involving the rape of a mentally challenged coed by three students, whose attorney claims they weren't aware of her condition.

videos.title: Tabloid
videos.overview: Tabloid journalism comes under scrutiny during the investigations into the deaths of a gossip columnist and a celebrity target he pursued.

videos.title: Monster
videos.overview: During the search for a pedophile who raped a 10-year-old, a snitch offers Briscoe a chance to avenge his daughter's death. Meanwhile, Van Buren learns that her job is in jeopardy; McCoy is ordered to appear before a disciplinary committee because of his conduct in a DUI case; and the increasingly political Schiff worries that the rape case may adversely impact his reelection bid.

videos.title: Cherished
videos.overview: The investigation into a girl's death reveals secrets the adoptive family was desperately trying to hide.

videos.title: DWB
videos.overview: Detectives discover a shocking twist involving unlikely suspects when they investigate the brutal beating of a black man dumped near the highway.

videos.title: Bait
videos.overview: The investigation into how a teen got wounded leads to a case involving a young woman's murder and a drug operation.

videos.title: Flight
videos.overview: After a child in a day-care center dies of a virus, Briscoe and Curtis try to find the source of the infection, leading to a case involving an extramarital affair, embezzlement and a drug manufacturer.

videos.title: Agony
videos.overview: After the detectives find a murdered postman and a woman who was left for dead in her apartment, the investigation leads to a serial killer and a surprise.

videos.title: Scrambled
videos.overview: The murder of an employee at a fertility clinic leads to a case involving a dead man's first and second wives.

videos.title: Venom
videos.overview: The killing of a professional escort leads to a case involving the relationships between a young man and two older women.

videos.title: Punk
videos.overview: The murder of a corrections officer leads detectives to a women's prison where a guard was linked to an inmate Carmichael put away on drug charges and a confrontation with defense attorney Danielle Melnick.

videos.title: True North
videos.overview: The double murder of a wealthy man and his daughter leads the detectives to the wife and stepmother of the deceased. However, Canada's objection to the death penalty hampers McCoy and Carmichael in seeking crucial evidence for obtaining a conviction.

videos.title: Hate
videos.overview: Evidence points the detectives in the direction of a fascist youth gathering after the brutal beating and murder of a high school girl.

videos.title: Ramparts
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis reopen a case that was closed in the '60s when a vehicle is dredged from the Hudson River containing the remains of a murdered man.

videos.title: Haven
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis probe the murder of a popular Harlem community leader while McCoy and Carmichael struggle to prevent a chaotic situation.

videos.title: Hunters
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis race against time to find the killer of a parolee before two bounty hunters find the suspected murderer.

videos.title: Sideshow (I)
videos.overview:
When Briscoe and Curtis discover that a high-level federal official found murdered was recently transferred from Baltimore, they re-team with Baltimore homicide detectives. The joint investigation reveals that the victim was involved in an affair with a high-level government official whose career will be destroyed if it becomes public. The independent counsel summons McCoy and Ed Danvers to Washington to demand McCoy reveal his source or be jailed for contempt.

This crossover continues on Homicide: Life on the Street S07E15 Sideshow (II).

videos.title: Disciple
videos.overview: After a teen is found dead in the emergency room, the investigation leads to a case involving a religious ritual and a defendant who claims that the action taken was dictated by a saint's voice.

videos.title: Harm
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis investigate a possible homicide while probing the assault of a retired divorce attorney.

videos.title: Shield
videos.overview: Briscoe and Curtis investigate the murder of a police officer who was shot while on an undercover stakeout.

videos.title: Juvenile
videos.overview: The investigation into the shooting of a newspaper columnist leads to a murder case from two decades earlier and involves a suspect who at that time had been a juvenile.

videos.title: Tabula Rasa
videos.overview: After a philosophy professor is pushed in front of a subway and killed, the investigation leads to a suspect who, following a divorce, changed his identity and disappeared with his daughters.

videos.title: Empire
videos.overview: The death of a corporate mogul caused by an overdose of a sexual performance-enhancing drug leads to a case with a witness that puts Curtis in a compromising position.

videos.title: Ambitious
videos.overview: The murder of an audio installation salesman leads the detectives to a case with connections to the mafia.

videos.title: Admissions
videos.overview: A coed's killing leads to a case involving the deceased's relationship with a professor and two male students who vouch for each other's whereabouts on the night of the murder.

videos.title: Refuge (1)
videos.overview: A shootout between a motorist and the police leads to the discovery of a gruesome Russian mob killing --- and a traumatized boy who was an eyewitness to the murder.

videos.title: Refuge (2)
videos.overview: McCoy and Carmichael risk violating the civil liberties of witnesses when they are forced to jail them in order to safely continue their investigation.

videos.title: Gunshow
videos.overview: A murderer's shooting spree in Central Park prompts Briscoe and his new partner, Detective Eddie Green, to trace the murder weapon's origination; McCoy makes it his mission to punish the killer and the gun manufacturer.

videos.title: Killerz
videos.overview: Briscoe and Green believe a 10-year-old is responsible for a child's death, and McCoy wants her isolated to stop any future fatalities.

videos.title: DNR
videos.overview: As Briscoe and Green investigate the shooting of judge, suspicion quickly points to her husband as the person who ordered the hit, but McCoy's case is hindered when she refuses to implicate her husband during the trial.

videos.title: Merger
videos.overview: The murder of a drug-laden teen presents the detectives with a host of suspects from her wealthy family.

videos.title: Justice
videos.overview: Jamie Ross returns as a defense attorney to represent a previous client who has key evidence concerning a prisoner on death row.

videos.title: Marathon
videos.overview: A frustrating investigation of a purse-snatching victim who was fatally shot leads to tension between Briscoe and Green over age and racial innuendoes. Briscoe notices his partner has developed a dangerous habit.

videos.title: Patsy
videos.overview: The investigation that follows the discovery of a comatose woman in her apartment leads to an unusual case involving murder and a possible frame-up, despite the prosecution having key DNA evidence to the contrary.

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: A taxi driver finds that his passenger is dead, leading the detectives to a case involving an insurance scam and Holocaust victims.

videos.title: Sundown
videos.overview: A patient is found beaten to death in a hospital lounge -- and the resulting case involves infidelity, Alzheimer's disease and a ladies' man.

videos.title: Loco Parentis
videos.overview: After sanitation workers find a teenage boy's body, the investigation leads to a school bully who displays an avid interest in martial-arts weapons, and whose father bought the murder weapon.

videos.title: Collision
videos.overview: The investigation of a schizophrenic woman's death leads to a case involving a homeless man and his right to refuse medication.

videos.title: Mother's Milk
videos.overview: Bloodstains in an apartment that belonged to a young couple with a baby leads to the separated parents, each of whom claims that the other has the infant.

videos.title: Panic
videos.overview: Briscoe and Green investigate the shooting of a best-selling mystery writer and the death of her accountant, with a love triangle as a possible motive for the crime.

videos.title: Entitled (II)
videos.overview:
The focus of the case returns to a politically influential family and, during the course of the trial, McCoy finds the powerful matriarch to be a formidable opponent.

The crossover starts on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S01E15 Entitled (I).

videos.title: Fools for Love
videos.overview: After the bodies of two teens are found, the detectives trace their identities and learn that one of them had a sister who was traveling with the girls.

videos.title: Trade This
videos.overview: The murder of a stockbroker points to organized crime when a hired hit man kills the prime suspect.

videos.title: Black, White and Blue
videos.overview: The murder of a white teen-ager in Harlem seems like an open-and-shut case until two patrol officers are implicated in the crime.

videos.title: Mega
videos.overview: The investigation into a helicopter bombing points to a victim's wife and her unconventional financial advisers.

videos.title: Surrender Dorothy
videos.overview: The body of a teacher, suspected of having an affair, is found in a car trunk and the investigation involves husband and father-in-law, both of whom are psychiatrists.

videos.title: Untitled
videos.overview: A wealthy woman, who is a patron of the arts, is found dead in her apartment and the ensuing investigation leads to a suspect whose violence was spurred by a painting similar to the crime scene.

videos.title: Narcosis
videos.overview: The discovery of a strangled prostitute's body leads to a case involving illegal immigrants and the events have an impact on a family.

videos.title: High & Low
videos.overview: Detectives Briscoe and Green probe the strangulation of a college coed who moonlighted as a stripper, and while they believe a pair of drug-dealing skinheads committed the murder, they struggle to determine the motive of the strip club owner who paid them for the hit. However, as they work their way up the ladder of complicity, the cops learn that the slaying is keyed to an insider trading scam that forces Assistant D.A. McCoy to connect a former porn star with a businessman.

videos.title: Stiff
videos.overview: The detectives' investigation into why a wealthy woman is comatose involves her husband, daughter and doctor.

videos.title: Vaya Con Dios
videos.overview: The death of an elderly man trying to find who was responsible for the torture killing of his son in 1973 Chile leads to a high-level foreign colonel who is now in a Manhattan hospital.

videos.title: Endurance
videos.overview: After a disabled boy dies of smoke inhalation during a fire, his parents and a building tenant with a history of ""accidental"" fires become suspects.

videos.title: Turnstile Justice
videos.overview: After a woman's body is found in a subway station, a suspect is arrested, but the resulting case concerns the lack of medication supplied him while in prison.

videos.title: Dissonance
videos.overview: The detectives investigate the murder of a young violinist whose fellow musicians resented her rapid rise to fame, in a trial that results in threats exchanged between Lewin and the presiding judge who has a history of bias against McCoy.

videos.title: Standoff
videos.overview: After a prisoner's murder, an investigation leads to a suspect, but the question arises if he acted on his own or on orders from within the prison.

videos.title: Return
videos.overview: The murder of a storeowner leads to a case where the suspect flees to Israel and may be protected from extradition by Israel's Law of Return.

videos.title: Burn Baby Burn
videos.overview: A former Black Panther, accused of murdering a Caucasian police officer, questions Green's integrity amidst a politically charged trial.

videos.title: Amends
videos.overview: Under pressure from the department's top brass, a 20-year-old murder case, initally investigated by Briscoe's now retired boss, is reopened involving the slaying of a teen-age girl with the spoiled son of a politically connected family as the prime suspect.

videos.title: Thin Ice
videos.overview: The killing of a school-hockey coach leads to a case in which the defendant claims that he committed the crime while suffering from ""sports rage.""

videos.title: Hubris
videos.overview: An assistant manager at a jewelers discovers four bodies at the store, leading to the prosecution of an amiable murder suspect who insists on representing himself, and winning the admiration of a female juror.

videos.title: Whose Monkey is it Anyway?
videos.overview: The death of a lab technician and the abduction of 17 infected monkeys lead to a trial involving the treatment of research animals.

videos.title: Sunday in the Park with Jorge
videos.overview: Following "wilding incidents" in Central Park, a woman's body is found in the lake and the suspects include the deceased's wealthy husband.

videos.title: Teenage Wasteland
videos.overview: The beating death of a restaurant owner leads Briscoe and Green to thrill-seeking teenagers; McCoy and Lewin are forced to decide how young is too young for the death penalty.

videos.title: Phobia
videos.overview: When a gay man is beaten to death during the abduction of his adopted infant son, Detectives Briscoe and Green suspect that ransom from the murder victim's wealthy partner may have been the motive for the crime. But as more is learned about the child's birth mother and homophobic biological father, Assistant D.A.'s McCoy and Carmichael find that what appeared to be a botched kidnapping might be more accurately prosecuted as a hate crime.

videos.title: A Losing Season
videos.overview: When a pregnant loan officer is found in the trunk of her car with fatal gunshot wounds, Detectives Briscoe and Green at first suspect a carjacking or the woman's fiance and co-worker. But as the woman's premature baby clings to life in the hospital, the investigation turns to professional basketball player Cris Cody, whose ties to the dead woman may extend beyond the loans she approved for him--and may include reason for him to want her and her unborn child dead.

videos.title: Swept Away - A Very Special Episode
videos.overview: When a participant in a TV reality show is murdered, McCoy goes after the producers and network executives for deliberately fomenting hostility among the participants to boost the ratings. All too appropriately, the outcome of the case hinges on a videotape made by a hidden-camera.

videos.title: Bronx Cheer
videos.overview: When a woman is found strangled to death with a large quantity of the drug Ecstasy in her handbag, Detectives Briscoe and Green have difficulty gathering sufficient evidence for an indictment of their prime suspect, drug-dealer Francis 'Taz' Partell. But when they question one of his former associates, they discover new evidence indicating that Taz is responsible for the earlier murder of a bouncer in Bronx county.

videos.title: Ego
videos.overview: When the dead body of Karen Hall, an investigator with the State Attorney General's Office Criminal Division, is found in a Manhattan river, Detectives Briscoe and Green find that her boss, Frank Conroy, had written off her disappearance as a random kidnapping from an Albany train station. But as more is learned about Conroy's controlling relationships -- with the dead woman, with his wife and with a long-term girlfriend -- he quickly becomes a suspect.

videos.title: White Lie
videos.overview: When a couple is found dead in their apartment, Detectives Briscoe and Green follow the trail of drugs and money, which leads to Caryn Wyman, the wife of a U.S. Army Major responsible for the country's anti-drug efforts in Colombia. Despite the evidence linking Caryn to the drugs, she is fearful of cooperating with the police--until A.D.A. McCoy convinces her and her husband that she has no choice but to risk her life to catch the killer.

videos.title: Whiplash
videos.overview: When an hispanic male is found dead from a severe chest trauma, Detectives Briscoe and Green discover that he and two other illegal immigrants had been in a staged automobile accident. As evidence mounts linking numerous similar car crashes with the same employer, chiropractor, insurance adjuster, and lawyers, A.D.A.s McCoy and Carmichael must determine who is ultimately responsible for the man's death, from which so many others profited.

videos.title: All My Children
videos.overview: The murder of a prep school student points to a mystery woman who may have been extorting money from the victim's wealthy father.

videos.title: Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: Briscoe and Green discover a murdered businessman may have been the target of a well-known criminal , but the investigation stumbles when the FBI acts as the suspect's alibi.

videos.title: School Daze
videos.overview: Jamie Ross returns to defend a student accused in a mass school slaying.

videos.title: Judge Dread
videos.overview: An attempted murder of a tough Judge leads Briscoe and Green on a wild goose chase to track down the inimical criminal. When the perpetrator is found, Carmichael and McCoy have a difficult time making a case.

videos.title: Deep Vote
videos.overview: A woman's murder leads the police to discover the actual target was a reporter who did a story about improprieties in a recent senatorial election. Carmichael can't get the reporter to reveal her sources for a story that contains allegations that the vote was fixed and ballots tampered with, even though the reporter's life is at risk. Without the source, McCoy and Carmichael have a difficult time making a case against the Senator, who they believe has ties to the mob and ordered the hit on the reporter. The case hinges on 2000 missing ballots from the vote that were stolen by the mob. Once the ballots are found, there is a big court battle about whether or not the ballots should be counted. McCoy believes that the ballots will show Benton's motive for ordering the hit, but an appellate court won't allow it, so their case is virtually dead. In the end, McCoy is able to convince the reporter to reveal her source and have him testify against the senator.

videos.title: Who Let the Dogs Out?
videos.overview: The investigation into the death of a jogger mauled by a vicious dog leads to an Attica inmate, his attorneys, and an underground dog-fighting ring.

videos.title: Armed Forces
videos.overview: The fatal stabbing of a man leads to the discovery of his status as a Vietnam war veteran and the truths uncovered about an incident that occured with him and three former soliders in his division.

videos.title: For Love or Money
videos.overview: The death of a parolee, who was a hit man, leads to a wealthy widow and daughter and whether they hired him to kill their rich relative.

videos.title: Soldier of Fortune
videos.overview: The daring daylight kidnapping of a diamond dealer which results in two murders at the scene uncovers an international dynasty of diamond sales and its links to a foreign civil war.

videos.title: Possession
videos.overview: Investigating the murder of a woman in a rent-controlled apartment, the detectives discover that she was engaged in a long-running battle with her landlord and had been blocking the potentially lucrative sale of the building.

videos.title: Formerly Famous
videos.overview: The shooting death of a former singer's wife leads the detectives to investigate his manager and sons after his explanation of the events surrounding her death have no credibility.

videos.title: Myth of Fingerprints
videos.overview: A murder investigation uncovers deliberately faulty forensics in the wrongful conviction of two men 12 years earlier in the case that paved the way for Van Buren's promotion.

videos.title: The Fire This Time
videos.overview: When a building is set ablaze, a girl must be identified despite her fatal burns. Through further investigation, it turns out that an extreme environmentalist group struck the match...

videos.title: 3 Dawg Night
videos.overview: When a celebrity is implicated in a nightclub murder, McCoy and Southerlyn battle the flaks who attempt to insulate their client from any involvement or interrogation.

videos.title: Prejudice
videos.overview: The murder of a magazine publishing company's black CEO leads to a suspect who has a clear streak of racism and whose attorney intends on using that as a mental defect.

videos.title: The Collar
videos.overview: The death of a cleric leads the detectives to a priest who was given information by a murder suspect outside of the church but insists that he can't discuss anything about it, bringing McCoy to question whether the confessional seal should apply.

videos.title: Undercovered
videos.overview: The father of a dying girl gets his revenge on an insurance executive who denied a certain leukemia treatment for his daughter. One problem arises when the father is technically on both sides of the law.

videos.title: DR 1-102
videos.overview: The bludgeoning of two women in their apartment leads the detectives to a suspect who has taken a hostage while demanding legal representation ... and Southerlyn's actions, while heroic, results in disbarment proceedings against her for violation of Disciplinary Rule 1-102.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: When a girl's parents frantically search for her, Briscoe and Green see that the girl's belongings were packed up in her apartment. They learn that the girl had been seeing a married man -- her boss. When the boss is brought up on charges, his wife sheds some new evidence.

videos.title: Access Nation
videos.overview: The murder of a psychologist leads to a case involving a computer company that sells information and their responsibility in shielding their clients' history in order to serve their needs.

videos.title: Born Again
videos.overview: The investigation into the death of an 11-year-old girl uncovers the possible culpability of the child's mother and a rebirthing therapist.

videos.title: Girl Most Likely
videos.overview: When a high school student is found dead in an apartment building, Briscoe and Green suspect that the murder was a result of her running a website. As McCoy and Southerlyn investigate the case further, they realize that her best friend, who was reluctant to come forward as a witness, may be the answer to the murder.

videos.title: Equal Rights
videos.overview: A stock analyst's murder leads the detectives to a corporation whose stock had fallen ... and plenty of suspects in the investors.

videos.title: Slaughter
videos.overview: The investigation of a student's killing leads to a case involving meat contamination at a food service.

videos.title: Dazzled
videos.overview: A woman is drugged and falls to her death, and the evidence suggests that her ex-boyfriend and her current husband's ex-wife may have conspired to kill her.

videos.title: Foul Play
videos.overview: The investigation into the death of a private investigator uncovers corruption, deceit, and immigration fraud in a Youth Baseball League whose manager will go to any lengths to win.

videos.title: Attorney Client
videos.overview: The wife of an attorney with many disgruntled clients is killed but the detectives believe that he was the intended target as he was willing to reveal information despite confidentially agreements. As the investigation continues, his tumultuous love life is exposed and the prosecutors are suspicious of his desire to return to the courtroom.

videos.title: Oxymoron
videos.overview: The investigation of a woman's strangulation leads to a case involving the selling of drugs and a gangster's son.

videos.title: Patriot
videos.overview: A tenement building explodes and the lone victim is Joseph Haden. The building was rent controlled and there had been a tenant strike, so the police initially suspect arson. But the landlord doesn't have insurance, ruling out their arson theory, and the medical examiner discovers that Haden's neck was broken and he was tied up before the explosion happened. Trying to figure out Haden is even more difficult. He didn't appear to have a family or a girlfriend and never got any substantial mail. He worked at the Jiffy Job service station making minimum wage, yet had $90,000 in the bank. Briscoe and Green do some more digging and find out that Haden was using an alias, and his real name was Yusuf Haddad.

videos.title: American Jihad
videos.overview: An American Muslim becomes the prime suspect in a double murder after an academic challenges his religious beliefs.

videos.title: Shangri-La
videos.overview: The murder of a female high school English teacher uncovers a love triangle that includes a female student and a male teacher, both of whom become suspects. The prosecutors have to deal with the student's multiple identities and refusal to live past adolescence.

videos.title: True Crime
videos.overview: Investigating the death of a rock band singer who had large amounts of cocaine and heroin in her system, the detectives question a former boyfriend who was a disgruntled band mate of her late husband. The prosecuters are hampered by the actions of a retired detective, who worked a case with Briscoe several years back, turned writer whose unconventional research tactics makes him a suspect as well.

videos.title: Tragedy on Rye
videos.overview: A struggling actress is murdered in an apparent robbery-homicide where a video tape, made by a couple touring the city sold to a local news station, shows three suspects loading the stolen property into an SUV. They are charged with felony murder, a capital crime, and causes unrest with Southerlyn surrounding the death penalty.

videos.title: The Ring
videos.overview: The discovery of a body in Hells Kitchen who had been wearing a $40,000 diamond ring leads the detectives back to the World Trade Center attacks as the victim had been reported to have died when Tower One collapsed. The ensuing investigation leads to a fiancee and a lover and the determination that the events of 9/11 may have been good timing to hide the fact that she was murdered the night before.

videos.title: Hitman
videos.overview: The execution style shooting of a city contractor leads Detectives Briscoe and Green to suspect a professional hitman. They first focus upon possible enemies of the victim, but end up suspecting the victim's wife and her boyfried of hiring the killer. However later discovered evidence leads McCoy and Southerlyn to a conspirator that no one had suspected.

videos.title: Open Season
videos.overview: A defense attorney who had just acquitted a cop killer is gunned down outside a Manhattan restaurant. The detectives start with police officers in the precinct of the injured officer, then to his brother, before they are led to a white supremacist who is part of a national network. McCoy is faced with the unlikely prospect that the defendant's attorney, his friend of 20 years and a friend of the slain lawyer, played a part in the murder of a Florida district attorney following the defendant's arrest. McCoy is able to make a deal that perserves the integrity of his adversary, but not without a cost.

videos.title: Asterisk
videos.overview: A star baseball player becomes the prime suspect in the murder of his limousine driver when it is discovered that the driver regularly supplied steroids to the sports icon. The subsequent investigation reveals blackmail as the underlying motive for the murder.

videos.title: The Wheel
videos.overview: The smoldering corpse of an Asian girl found outside the Chinese consul general's apartment leads the detectives to believe she had made a political statement. When forensics shows that she had been murdered beforehand, they find themselves in the middle of a religious conflict with the consul general their prime suspect and his attorney an old friend of District Attorney Branch.

videos.title: Mother's Day
videos.overview: The hit-and-run death of a popular high-school student leaves the detectives suspecting the girl's father was the real target. When evidence reveals that the death was possibly a random killing, they are able to track down their suspect to his apartment. However things get complicated when their killer is murdered, and the person who committed the crime happens to be the victim's mother.

videos.title: Chosen
videos.overview: The murder of a bookie with a high-class clientelle leads the detectives to arrest his partner. Charged with first-degree murder, his attorney puts forth an unusual defense strategy that turns the trial into a political statement.

videos.title: Under God
videos.overview: A dead teenager's father and a vigilante priest are suspects in the killing of a drug dealer.

videos.title: Absentia
videos.overview: When the witness in a jewelry store robbery-homicide fails to appear in court, McCoy suspects foul play until he discovers that the man is a fugitive in a 20-year-old murder case.

videos.title: Star Crossed
videos.overview: The bludgeoning of a luxury sports car dealer leads the detectives to a mentally challenged man and his girlfriend who is extremely attractive and whose expensive tastes leads her to be equally manipulative.

videos.title: Bitch
videos.overview: The death of a stockbroker leads the detectives to his girlfriend whose mother is a cosmetics mogul who has a long standing friendship with Branch, and will stop at nothing to protect her corporate image by using hormone replacement therapy withdrawal as the basis for her defense.

videos.title: Suicide Box
videos.overview: A media-savvy attorney defends a black teenager accused of shooting an off-duty policy officer.

videos.title: Genius
videos.overview: Investigating the murder of a cab driver, the detectives come to suspect a famous author and his protege, a former child prodigy.

videos.title: Maritime
videos.overview: A missing football player becomes the prime suspect in the murder of a woman whose body is discovered floating in the East River.

videos.title: Seer
videos.overview: The prime suspect in the murder of a woman outside a sex club claims to have merely witnessed the crime via a psychic vision.

videos.title: Kid Pro Quo
videos.overview: The murder of an admissions director of a private school leads the detectives to investigate a pair of angry parents whose children were denied admission, but then set their sights on the headmaster when they discover that the victim was about to go public with the denied admissions.

videos.title: House Calls
videos.overview: The suspicious death of a Russian model leads the detectives to suspect medical malpractice.

videos.title: Sheltered
videos.overview: It's a race against time as the detectives go on the hunt for a sniper whose victims are shot in broad daylight.

videos.title: Couples
videos.overview: Briscoe and Green catch four murders and a kidnapping on the same day, and get handed confessions in each case.

videos.title: Smoke
videos.overview: Briscoe and Green are assigned to a case involving an eccentric comedian who may have killed his young son by dangling him off a ledge.

videos.title: Bodies
videos.overview: While investigating the death of a teenaged girl, the detectives stumble on a pattern of crimes that indicate they are after a serial killer. The suspect, however, puts the prosecutors through an ethical ringer when he discloses his attorney's knowledge of the victims and their whereabouts.

videos.title: Bounty
videos.overview: The investigation into the murder of a bounty hunter leads to a reporter with compromised ethics and a dubious defense strategy.

videos.title: Patient Zero
videos.overview: The investigation into the carjacking of a vehicle containing vials of a deadly virus leads the detectives on a search for the first person infected with the virus and a biochemist whose sinister motivations were driven by passion.

videos.title: Shrunk
videos.overview: The police and prosecutors investigate the connection between an award-winning songwriter and the young woman found murdered in his home to discover who would profit by her death at his hands.

videos.title: Blaze
videos.overview: A teenager's need for parental love, acceptance and recognition sets in motion the events leading to the deaths of 23 concert goers for a band's illegal pyrotechnics.

videos.title: Identity
videos.overview: When a man is found murdered shortly after depositing almost $400,000 in his savings account, the investigation into the source of funds reveals that the victim ran an identity theft scam which left an elderly man homeless and impoverished.

videos.title: Floater
videos.overview: The husband of a woman whose partially decomposed body is found floating in the Hudson River becomes the prime suspect in her murder until the prosecutors uncover a connection between her prospective attorney and a judge who has heard a suspiciously high number of his cases.

videos.title: Embedded
videos.overview: After a reporter accused of causing the deaths of soldiers with whom he was embedded in Iraq by reporting on their troop movements is shot and wounded on the eve of his return to the front, the ballistics report indicates that the gun belonged to one of the dead soldiers, leading the detectives to uncover who brought the gun back from the front and committed the crime.

videos.title: Compassion
videos.overview: When a con man passing himself off as a grief counselor is poisoned by a respected doctor he victimized, McCoy must determine whether revenge or insanity prompted the crime.

videos.title: Ill-Conceived
videos.overview: The owner of a clothing company with alien immigrant workers is found murdered which sends the detectives on a search for an unidentified evening caller whose girlfriend, also a worker in the factory, recently gave birth. Upon discovery that the victim was also the baby's father, the boyfriend is arrested with the motive being an office affair until the victim's widow discloses that it was a surrogate arrangement.

videos.title: Darwinian
videos.overview: The apparent hit-and-run of a homeless man send the detectives on a search for the driver, a high profile female publicist, which fuels the fire for the prosecutors to obtain a murder conviction. Forensic evidence given during the trial reveal that the victim was severely beaten before being hit by the car which leads to a suspect within the homeless community.

videos.title: Payback
videos.overview: The investigation into the murder of a former bookie turned mob informant reveals a disturbing new wrinkle in organized crime involving legitimate businessmen moonlighting as contract hitmen in a battle for mob leadership, and ends with a Federal ploy to nullify the plea bargain in the case, leaving McCoy seething and two more people dead.

videos.title: Married with Children
videos.overview: The death of a woman who fell from a hotel balcony leads to a case involving a lesbian couple and a state law banning gay adoption

videos.title: City Hall
videos.overview: A city employee's clerical error sets in motion a chain of events which culminates in a fatal shooting at City Hall and a secret Federal court proceeding with sinister implications.

videos.title: Veteran's Day
videos.overview: A decorated Gulf War veteran grief-stricken over the Afghanistan combat death of his son murders an anti-war protester, claiming at trial that he acted under extreme emotional distress.

videos.title: Can I Get a Witness?
videos.overview: McCoy faces an uphill battle in proving that witnesses to the murder of a drug mule were bribed, intimidated, and eventually murdered on the orders of the drug dealer accused of the crime.

videos.title: Hands Free
videos.overview: When McCoy fails to win a murder conviction against an eccentric cross dressing millionaire for the death of his neighbor, he redoubles the effort to convict the man for murdering his second wife years earlier by demonstrating that he murdered a witness to the crime.

videos.title: Evil Breeds
videos.overview: When a Holocaust survivor is murdered on the eve of her testimony in the deportation trial of a former concentration camp guard, McCoy prosecutes the man and the Neo-Nazi sympathizer who's running a fundraising web site for him, and must debunk a Holocaust denial defense which claims that the millions of deaths resulted from disease, pestilence and wartime conditions.

videos.title: Nowhere Man
videos.overview: The District Attorney's Office is set on its ear when the investigation into the death of an A.D.A. uncovers a scandal that could imperil hundreds of cases.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raimondo's
videos.overview: Greed, treachery and disrespect shape the motives for murder when two men are gunned down at an exclusive restaurant.

videos.title: Vendetta
videos.overview: The investigation into a bar room brawl fatality reveals a detective's decades-old vendetta against a petty criminal turned murderer who was falsely accused of one murder after evading conviction on another.

videos.title: Gaijin
videos.overview: Van Buren has reservations about Branch's tactics in luring a Ginza nightclub owner back to New York after the Japanese government is unwilling to extradite him to face charges of conspiracy and murder in the death of his wife on a New York City vacation.

videos.title: Caviar Emptor
videos.overview: When a caviar importer is murdered the day after his wedding to a much-younger woman, the large pool of suspects includes his new wife, his children, and his chief competitor, each of whom has a compelling motive for committing the crime.

videos.title: C.O.D.
videos.overview: Briscoe bids farewell to the 27 as the prosecution of two women for killing each other's husbands comes to a successful conclusion.

videos.title: Paradigm
videos.overview: An Iraqi immigrant who murders a former military policewoman in retaliation for torturing her brother at Abu Ghraib prison claims that she is covered as an enemy combatant under the terms of the Geneva Convention.

videos.title: The Dead Wives Club
videos.overview: When a woman abandoned by her firefighter husband for his partner's widow is threatened with also losing custody of her children, she murders her romantic rival, claiming that 9/11 post-traumatic stress syndrome prompted her actions.

videos.title: The Brotherhood
videos.overview: When a prison gang puts out a contract on a Sing Sing corrections officer and his family, assigning the job to a newly released ex-con, the terrified officer pleads preemptive self-defense after he's brought to trial for the parolee's murder. As the trial proceeds, the gang attempts to affect the outcome of the case by sending a death threat to the presiding judge, who refuses to be intimidated. Shortly after the conclusion of the trial, McCoy discovers that the defendant's fears about the power and the reach of the gang were well-placed.

videos.title: Coming Down Hard
videos.overview: McCoy goes after the C.E.O. of a pharmaceutical company who knowingly commissioned further clinical trials on a drug to extend its patent protection yielding millions of dollars of profit without disclosing that previous clinical studies had demonstrated that the drug created a high risk of suicide in its users.

videos.title: Gunplay
